findings.title: Another person's Herder could task or read your Herder
findings.problem: give_task and read_reply never refused a Herder as the target. Sam's Herder could task the Farm's Herder (assistant) and read its reply, which now holds relayed private-bot replies.
findings.fix: Herders can't task or read any Herder (herder_message). Test a_herder_never_tasks_or_reads_another_herder failed before the fix.

findings.title: The "read web content" flag cleared every message, but Claude remembers
findings.problem: A page read in one message could steer Herder in the next message, with no card before tasking a private bot.
findings.fix: The flag lasts the whole Claude session and is saved with it (migration 10); only a new session clears it. Prompt no longer says exactly when the card shows.

findings.title: Only browser results and bot replies counted as untrusted
findings.problem: File reads, other people's bot descriptions in list_bots and future tools were trusted.
findings.fix: Allowlist: every tool result counts except oxbot's own team tools, which mark the session when they return someone else's words. Descriptions sent as escaped <bot_purpose> data.

findings.title: No tests for when the flag starts and ends
findings.problem: read_reply, a second task after a reply, across messages, list_bots and file reads were untested.
findings.fix: Seven new hub tests plus store and unit tests.

findings.title: Page and README still said Herder can't task private bots
findings.problem: Users chose private bots partly on that promise.
findings.fix: Text now says your own Herder can, and asks first after reading web content or other bots' replies. The card says what Herder read.

findings.title: Viewers resolved ad hoc; resolve() created people on read paths
findings.problem: A forgotten resolve fell back to name matching; any name made a person.
findings.fix: resolve only looks up; a name alone gives no access. A test-only feature keeps older tests' implicit people; production builds don't get it (checked with cargo tree).

findings.title: People were created six ways; only two told the clients
findings.problem: New people missed the people list; check-then-act in add_gate.
findings.fix: One person_named path that announces; add_gate returns "new" from one transaction.

findings.title: Sign-in lists, notices and cards went to people by name
findings.problem: After a rename and a new pairing under the old name, one person's sites or task text could reach another.
findings.fix: Server-only id fields; routing compares person ids. JSON to clients unchanged.

findings.title: Old bot makers not in the database got a new empty Chrome folder
findings.problem: Their saved sign-ins were cut off for good.
findings.fix: A legacy path keeps the folder and Herder id an older oxbot used.

findings.title: store.rs did four jobs; migration 9 called live code
findings.problem: A later change to folder or Herder naming would upgrade old databases differently.
findings.fix: store/ split by job (pure move); migration 9 uses frozen copies pinned by a golden test.

findings.title: Reconnecting replayed every missed event one by one
findings.problem: After the Mac sleeps, a busy bot sent thousands of single events and froze the page; oxbot chat replayed everything.
findings.fix: A long gap gets one page of the latest events; oxbot chat opens by page; JSON parsed after the store lock.

findings.title: No guard or backup for going back to an older oxbot
findings.problem: Migration 9 rebuilds tables; an older oxbot would lock phones out and lose sign-in lists.
findings.fix: A newer database is refused with a clear error; the file is copied (VACUUM INTO) to oxbot.db.v8.bak before rebuilding.

findings.title: A cancelled sign-in stayed listed if the site set any cookie
findings.problem: Almost every site sets consent cookies on load.
findings.fix: Kept only if the window left a new cookie (names only are compared, never values).

findings.title: The split is files only; Hub still holds every field
findings.problem: Each feature edits several hub files.
findings.fix: Taint and latest numbers moved into their own small types (taint.rs, seqs.rs). A People type is left for later.

findings.title: Endless "load older" requests on an empty page
findings.fix: Fixed: the page always moves back.

findings.title: A deleted bot's card could write history
findings.fix: Fixed: confirm skips a deleted bot.

findings.title: Latest numbers were zero if the start-up read failed
findings.fix: Fixed: per-bot fallback.

findings.title: Farm person renamed from a fallback name, silently
findings.fix: Fixed: only the Mac account name renames; logged and announced.

findings.title: Pairing as "jay" could become the Farm's person "Jay"
findings.fix: Fixed: never folds case onto the Farm's person; codes carry the person id.

findings.title: Old ownerless private bots were given to the Farm person
findings.fix: Fixed for private bots (stay Farm-only). Old shared bots still go to the Farm person (an existing test pins it).

findings.title: Phone copy kept or dropped chats by name; old pages kept
findings.fix: Fixed: uses the Farm's locked flag; pages in one transaction, older than 30 days skipped.

findings.title: Nothing stopped two Farm people or shared folders
findings.fix: Fixed: migration 11 adds unique folder, Herder and one-Farm indexes.

findings.title: Other line breaks (U+2028 etc.) could fake a sender
findings.fix: Fixed.

findings.title: "private" read from the card's wording
findings.fix: Fixed: policy::Ask.private.

findings.title: C4 page out of date
findings.fix: Updated with person ids, the hub layout and migrations 8–11.

findings.title: Wi-Fi name in the info log
findings.fix: Left: the live log only goes to the Mac.

findings.title: Sites still one message told apart by owner (old m21)
findings.fix: Left: tests pin it.

findings.title: Your own Herder already browses with your sign-ins, so the card mostly matters for the main Herder
findings.fix: A later card for opening a URL that carries data after untrusted reading.

findings.title: Events have no retention plan
findings.fix: Plan an archive before millions of rows per bot.

findings.title: Removing a Gate keeps that person's Chrome folder
findings.fix: A "forget person" action later.
